messages:
Sora Tan: Hi all! Sora here — joining as a Customer Solutions Engineer. Based in Austin, I bake sourdough and scones on weekends and bring too many questions. Happy to be here :wave:
Maya Chen: Welcome Sora!! :tada: Austin meetup crew is small but mighty. Where in Austin are you?
Sora Tan: South Austin near Zilker. Any breakfast recs or local bakeries? Also curious about desk plant policies for when I visit SF office.
Iris (People Ops): Welcome! We'll get you set up with the onboarding schedule. Desk plants are allowed but low-maintenance ones only (no soil mess) — front desk handles clearing if needed.
Devon Park: Welcome Sora! For breakfast try Easy Tiger or Paperboy — both solid. Also if you ever want recipe swaps I'm in.
Sora Tan: Ooh thanks! I will try Paperboy. Recipe swap sounds fun. Maybe we can do a "bring-your-baked-good" virtual show-and-tell?
Maya Chen: Love that idea. Quick poll: should we do a virtual bake-off or a casual hangout with snacks? React with :cupcake: for bake-off or :cookie: for casual hangout.
ops-bot: Poll created: "New-hires bake event type" — 24h voting window. Options: :cupcake: Bake-off, :cookie: Casual hangout.
Devon Park: Also FYI there's a monthly "snacks & stories" where new folks share something they made. I'll add Sora to the invite.
Sora Tan: That sounds lovely, thanks everyone. Shirt size L, happy to DM address for swag. Looking forward to meeting y'all (virtually at least) :smile:
